own_integrations:
- "nexdeck: integration
short: bookstack-own
name: BookStack
logo: bookstack
\
  description: Documentation in books, chapters and pages.
category: other
fields:
\
  \  - name: token_id
    type: text
    label: Token ID
    help: Profile > API\
  \ Tokens > Create Token.
    required: true
  - name: token_secret
    type:\
  \ secret
    label: Token secret
    required: true
auth:
  type: header
 \
  \ header: Authorization
  value: "Token {token_id}:{token_secret}"
test: /api/books?count=1
\
  test_expects: json
reads:
  - path: /api/books?count=10
    label: Books
  -\
  \ path: /api/pages?count=10&sort=-updated_at
    label: Latest pages
github: BookStackApp/BookStack
"
